title: The carrier of positive densities is H^n-measurable (printed 'M is H^n-measurable')
statement: Let V be an n-varifold on U ⊆ ℝ^N, μ := μ_V, M ⊆ U with μ(ℝ^N ∖ M) = 0, and θ : ℝ^N → ℝ with θ(x) > 0 and Θ^n(μ, x) = θ(x) (HasDensity n μ x (ENNReal.ofReal θ(x))) for every x ∈ M. Then M is H^n-null-measurable.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ), M ⊆ U → V.weight Mᶜ = 0 → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x ∧ HasDensity n V.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))) → NullMeasurableSet M μHE[n]
